remarks: UNIT NO. 6D IS THE ULTIMATE FLEX -- This is a high vibe, high floor, very large 797 square footer 1 BR/BTH at the Crosswinds, known as a classic Junior Four Separation with a real kitchen, real dining space, real living room and a large bedroom down the hall, a trad yet open floorplan that's harder to come by vs. small white boxes, plus newly installed wood floors, newly painted walls, high ceilings and big windows with an endless supply of natural light, skyline views, all day, everyday. This rental is *KEY* in so many ways -- your heat, hot water, cooking gas and designated parking spot are included in your rent, laundry on the same floor. Stamford's hottest restaurants, bars, shopping, popping downtown events, public transportation, train station are all close by. Let this be your power move and settle in before this gets away. No smoking, no animals, strong credit no exceptions, renter's liability ins. required, employment/reference verification.
